No.: 17/429,053 Response dated April 29, 2025 Reply to Response to File Corrected Application Papers dated March 10, 2025 REMARKS/ARGUMENTSThe Notice to File Corrected Application Papers asserted that on page 7 - paragraph 0045, last line is missing text.In response, paragraph 0045 has been amended to correct formality issues noted by the Publication Branch.In addition, Applicant has amended paragraph 0037, on page 7, to insert a period at the end of the phrase.The Applicant hereby states that the substituted paragraphs submitted herewith contain no new matter.Concluding Remarks The Applicant submits that the present application is in condition for allowance and requests early and favorable disposition.The Commissioner is hereby authorized to treat this and any subsequent response as including a petition for any necessary extension of time and to charge any additional fees, and credit any over payments, to Deposit Account No. 192550.Any questions regarding this submission or this application should be directed to the undersigned 514-871-2922 or dstmartin@smartbiggar.ca.Respectfully submitted, David St-Martin Reg. No. 58,225 Tel.: 514.871.2922 April 29, 2025 - 3- 9287479
